caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 3
description: The HP Integrated Lights-Out 5 (HP iLO 5) built into HP ProLiant Gen10 and Synergy(480 and 660) servers is an autonomous secure management component embedded directly on the server motherboard. iLO helps simplify initial server setup, power and thermal optimization, remote server administration, and provides server health monitoring with the HP Active Health System (AHS).
